adaptations.agv_charge_count_ramp: Four-vehicle ramp retained from the confirmed main-budget base.
adaptations.agv_run_power_per_vehicle_kw: Reference has 15 kW container and 18 kW LOHC duties; clean schema has one coefficient, so the conservative 18 kW value is used.
adaptations.c3_work_capacity_caps: The baseline 13-vehicle C3 working-state split of 7:6 is scaled to the 60-vehicle fleet and rounded to 32:28 whole-vehicle caps; idle and charging remain pooled.
adaptations.grid_sell_capacity_kw: Clean schema supports the intended separate 50 MW sell cap.
adaptations.ship_delay: Four 15-minute steps and at most two delayed ships retained.
adaptations.wind_budget: Gamma=12 retained from the certificate-clean formal spec.

spill_cost_selection.observed_transition: Worst-case spill deviation is 0.025 MWh at 0.10 and 0 MWh from 0.125 through 0.30.
spill_cost_selection.selection_rule: Smallest scanned value strictly above the 0.10 yuan/kWh marginal tie with the 0.20 yuan/kWh grid-deviation cost.
